content: Material: Made from high-quality, stretchable fabric, it provides excellent mobility and support during your active sessions. The dress is breathable and moisture-wicking, keeping you cool and dry even in intense matches
Features:Designed with a sleek, fitted silhouette, this dress features a functional front zipper for easy wear and adjustable comfort.

2 In 1 Tennis Dress:Workout dress with built-in mesh shorts & but no bra for a total coverage and ease of movement, you can reach to return every serve without anything holding you back. Plus, two side pockets are added in undershorts are great for keeping your essentials within reach.
Chic Side Slit Feature: A tasteful side slit not only adds a touch of elegance to this already fashionable tennis dress but also enhances your mobility on the court
Its versatile design transitions seamlessly from sporty to casual, allowing you to stay stylish whether you’re playing tennis, golf, running errands, or meeting up with friends.
